description:
Player-count history for one server. The per-poll `player_count`/`queued_count` readings behind the server page's 24-hour chart, oldest first,
as `points` of `{t, players, queued}`. One reading lands per poll cycle (roughly hourly); when the window
holds more than 500 readings they are averaged into equal time buckets (`resolution_seconds`, null when the
points are raw) so a response never exceeds 500 points. Also `peak_players`, `avg_players` and `point_count`.
A server that has never answered a poll has an empty series. Cached for five minutes.

days.description: How many days back to return (1-30). Snapshots are pruned nightly to the configured retention window (7 days by default - see `snapshot_retention_days` on `/servers/stats`), so longer ranges come back only as far as the table holds.

name: get_server_player_history
title: Player-count history for one server
